_date: DERIVED from the level number — see game/calendar.ts. Shift 2 is Wednesday 3 March.
_verdict_mode: Pass, Warning or Fine. One warning before a fine, always.
_teaching: Bins arrive on the one day they are legal — the object is learned before it is ever a finding. And the first FINE: 4412 was warned on Monday and has not cut its weeds.
briefing: Collection day. Containers at the curb are within the window today. And one address on this route was warned on Monday: if it has not been put right, that is a fine.
_cameos: Named residents pinned to addresses rather than rolled. Anything not pinned stays random, so the street is still mostly strangers.
_ambient_animals: The animals loose in yards on this shift. Nights are the wild ones; days are the neighbourhood cat.
story: Wednesday. Collection day on Bonerville, so half the street has bins at the curb.
That is permitted today. Article IX allows Tuesday and Wednesday. It does not allow Thursday, and residents are aware of this.
From today you may also issue a fine. One warning first — always. A fine on a first sighting will not survive appeal, and the Association pays the costs.

lots._teaching: Bins at the curb on the one day they are legal. The object is introduced BEFORE it is ever a finding, so the player learns to read the calendar rather than the silhouette.
Screened bins, which are compliant on any day at all — the decoy that survives once Friday arrives and the curb ones do not.

decoys.why: Screened from the street. Compliant on any day.

lots._teaching: Weeds at an address that was warned on Monday for its FENCE. A different article, so this is a first offence and a warning — escalation is per article, and this lot is where that is demonstrated rather than stated.

violations.why: Unbordered growth through the front turf.

lots._teaching: THE FIRST FINE. Same weeds, same address, two days later. Correct only if the player issued the warning on Monday — miss that and this is another warning, and stamping a fine here becomes the error.

violations.why: Still here. Warned Monday, uncut Wednesday.

lots._teaching: Two live articles, one legal object. The bins are fine and the fence is not, on the same lot, so neither can be answered by mood.
